signatures.description: FTP server may allow anonymous login (USER anonymous / PASS anonymous). Verify with the ftp_anonymous_login_check validation check.

vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a known source-code backdoor: a username containing a smiley face (':)') opens a shell listener on TCP 6200. Scripter does not trigger this backdoor automatically - confirm manually and only within an authorized lab/competition scope.

signatures.cve: N/A - compromised source tarball, no CVE assigned
signatures.description: ProFTPD 1.3.3c was distributed from a compromised mirror with a backdoor added to the source tarball (Nov 2010). Manual confirmation required; no automated check implemented.

UnrealIRCd 3.2.8.1 distribution packages (Nov 2009-Jun 2010) contained a backdoored Util.c allowing arbitrary command execution. Service was identified by port/protocol only - confirm the exact build manually before treating this as more than a hypothesis.

Samba 3.0.20-3.0.25rc3 'username map script' allows remote command execution via shell metacharacters in the username field. Service identified by port only - version could not be fingerprinted by banner; confirm the Samba version manually.

signatures.cve: N/A - end-of-life version, multiple historical CVEs may apply to the exact build
signatures.description: OpenSSH version banner indicates an old, end-of-life release. Check the exact point release against known CVEs for that version before treating this as more than a lead.

Apache Tomcat detected (Coyote connector in the Server header). The /manager/html console, if exposed with default or weak credentials, allows WAR upload and remote code execution. Scripter does not attempt credential login automatically (avoids brute force) - check manually.

signatures.cve: N/A - missing authentication; related RCE paths documented under CVE-2022-24735/CVE-2022-24736
signatures.description: Redis instance may accept commands without authentication. Verify with the redis_unauthenticated_check validation check, which only issues PING.

signatures.cve: N/A - protocol downgrade exposure; see CVE-2014-3566 (POODLE) for the SSLv3 case
signatures.description: Service may still negotiate SSLv3/TLS1.0. Verify with the tls_weak_protocol_check validation check, which only performs a handshake.
